_: Where a tapped word opens, for a form that is also the dictionary form of a noun the course does not teach (2026-10-05: «Моя кружка зелёная» opened «кружок», 'circle, ring', because «кружка» is also its genitive). Read only by build_site.py build_deep_forms, so a tap opens the noun while grading, the curriculum's word counts and the video index are untouched (those read lemma_overrides.json). Value: bare|pos. Chosen by reading every such key (data/_work, 135 of them): only where the other noun is clearly the commoner reading — «вод» stays «вода», «лет» stays «год», «смог» stays «смочь».
